blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) achieve high-fidelity image and video generation, but they suffer from substantial inference costs due to repeated transformer evaluations across many denoising steps. Feature caching reduces this cost by reusing features across denoising steps. Recent forecasting methods extend this idea by extrapolating features to skipped steps instead of reusing them. However, existing forecasting methods extrapolate the features they predict uniformly, even though the spatial-frequency components of these features change most at different stages of denoising. They also overlook that denoising progresses nonuniformly, so equal step intervals can correspond to very different amounts of change. These mismatches amplify forecast errors as more steps are skipped, limiting the achievable acceleration. We propose SpecKCast, a training-free method that forecasts the model output in the frequency domain. SpecKCast applies a 2D discrete cosine transform (DCT) to the output and tracks each coefficient with a lightweight Kalman filter along a band-specific time coordinate derived from the noise schedule. The filter tracks each coefficient's value and rate of change, and the transformer is evaluated only when the filter's forecast uncertainty exceeds a threshold. Experiments on FLUX.1-dev, Qwen-Image, Wan2.1-14B, and HunyuanVideo show that SpecKCast achieves a better trade-off between acceleration and fidelity than existing caching and forecasting methods, reaching up to 6x speedup with less than 0.05 GiB of additional memory.
blocks.zh: 扩散变压器(DiTs)实现了高真实度的图像和视频生成,但由于在许多去诺步骤中反复进行变压器评价,它们承受了巨大的推论成本. 地物缓存通过在取名步骤中重新使用地物来降低这一成本. 最近的预测方法通过推断特征来扩展这个想法来跳过步骤而不是再用. 然而,现有的预测方法可以推断出它们一致预测的特征,尽管这些特征的空间-频率组成部分在不同的去名阶段变化最大. 它们也忽略了不统一地否认进步,因此,相等的步相间隔可以对应非常不同的变化量. 随着更多步骤被跳过,这些不匹配会扩大预测错误,限制了可实现的加速. 我们提出SpecKCast,一种无训练方法,用来预测频率域的模型输出. SpecKCast对输出采用2D离散余弦变换(DCT),并用轻量级卡尔曼滤波器沿着由噪声表产生的波段特定时间坐标来跟踪每个系数. 滤波器跟踪每个系数的值和变化率,而变压器只有在滤波器的预测不确定性超过阈值时才会被评价. 关于FLUX.1-dev,Quen-Image,Wan2.1-14B,和HunyuanVideo的实验显示,斯佩克克卡斯特在加速和忠诚之间实现更好的取舍,比起现有的缓存和预测方法,达到最高6x加速,额外内存小于0.05 GiB.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Diffusion models ( Ho et al., 2020 ) have become the dominant paradigm for high-fidelity visual generation, gaining significant attention from recent advances in image and video generation. Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) ( Peebles and Xie, 2023 ) further improved generation quality by enabling greater model capacity. However, their costly forward passes throughout many denoising steps lead to substantially higher inference latency, limiting their use in real-time applications. To address this bottleneck, a wide range of acceleration techniques have been proposed to reduce either the step count or the per-step cost, including efficient attention ( Xia et al., 2025 ) , step distillation ( Salimans and Ho, 2022 ) , and quantization ( Li et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 传播模式(Ho等人,2020年)已成为高真能视觉生成的主导范式,从图像和视频生成的近期进步中获得显著关注. 扩散变压器(DiTs)(Peebles and Xie,2023)通过增强模型能力进一步提高生成质量. 然而,在许多取消提名的步骤中,其昂贵的前进通道导致推断延迟率大幅提高,限制了其在实时应用中的使用。 为了解决这一瓶颈问题,提出了广泛的加速技术,以减少步数或每步成本,包括高效注意(霞等人,2025年),步蒸馏(萨利曼人和何人,2022年),以及量化(李等人,2023年).

blocks.en: Among these, feature caching has emerged as a practical, training-free approach. Motivated by the observation that model outputs are highly similar across adjacent timesteps, these methods cache features from previous steps and reuse them in subsequent ones, skipping substantial computation ( Ma et al., 2024 ; Selvaraju et al., 2024 ) . However, this similarity decays as the gap between timesteps grows, so naive reuse over longer spans significantly degrades generation quality, limiting caching to modest acceleration ratios. To address this, recent work shifts from reusing features to forecasting them ( Liu et al., 2025b ; Han et al., 2026 ) . Rather than assuming that a cached feature remains valid at a later timestep, forecasting methods exploit temporal continuity along the denoising trajectory, using features from previous steps to estimate their evolution and extrapolate their values at the target timestep. By modeling temporal drift, forecasting remains effective across wider timestep gaps, enabling higher acceleration ratios at comparable generation quality.
blocks.zh: 其中,特征缓存已经成为一种实用的、无培训的方法。 由于观察到模型输出在相邻时间步骤之间高度相似,这些方法从前几个步骤中缓存特征,并在后几个步骤中重复使用,从而跳过了实质性计算(Ma等人,2024年;Selvaraju等人,2024年)。 然而,这种相似性随着时间跨度差距的增大而衰减,因此在较长的时间内天真地再利用会显著降低生成质量,将缓存限制在适度的加速率. 为了解决这一问题,最近的工作从再利用地物转向预测地物(Liu等人,2025年b); Han et al., 2026) (中文(中国大陆) ). 预测方法不是假定缓存特征在以后阶段仍然有效,而是利用去诺音轨沿线的时间连续性,利用以前步骤的特征来估计其演变,并在目标时间步骤推断其值。 通过模拟时间漂移,预测在较长的时段差距中依然有效,从而能够在可比的生成质量下提高加速率。

blocks.en: Despite their promise, existing forecasting approaches impose uniformity on both what they forecast and how they model the signal over time ( Liu et al., 2025b ; Han et al., 2026 ) . First, they extrapolate the model output or feature representation as a whole, or apply the same forecasting rule uniformly to all of its components (e.g., channels), even though the spatial-frequency components of the signal evolve very differently. As Figure 2 shows, low-frequency content changes sharply in the first few steps and then settles, while high-frequency content changes slightly at first but evolves rapidly toward the end. Because these bands are active at different stages, a single uniform forecaster may not serve them all. Second, existing methods use the sampler’s step index or raw diffusion timestep as their temporal coordinate, even though the amount of denoising performed at each step is nonuniform and depends on the scheduler. Therefore, equal intervals in the chosen coordinate can represent very different amounts of denoising progress. Treating these intervals as equivalent makes the resulting trajectory harder to model and forecast. Together, these limitations restrict achievable acceleration, amplify forecast errors, and degrade generation quality as the skip length increases.
blocks.zh: 现有预测方法尽管有承诺,但对其预测内容和如何在一段时间内模拟信号都具有统一性(Liu等人,2025b); Han et al., 2026) (中文(中国大陆) ). 首先,它们推导模型输出或特征表示整体,或者对它的所有组件(如通道)统一应用同样的预测规则,尽管信号的空间频率组件进化非常不同. 如图2所示,低频内容在最初的几个步骤中发生剧烈变化,然后稳定下来,而高频内容起初略有变化,但向最后迅速演变。 由于这些乐队在不同阶段都活跃,所以一个统一的预测器可能不会为它们全部服务. 第二,现有方法使用采样器的阶梯指数或原始扩散时间步骤作为其时间坐标,即使每个阶梯的去诺量不是统一的,取决于排程器。 因此,所选坐标的相同间隔可以代表非常不同的去名化进展. 将这些间隔作为等效的处理,使得所产生的轨迹更难于建模和预测. 这些限制加在一起限制了可实现的加速,扩大了预测错误,并随着跳过长度的增加而降低了生成质量.

blocks.en: Motivated by this insight, we propose SpecKCast, a training-free method that rethinks both what we forecast and how we extrapolate. The key idea is to forecast the model’s temporal evolution separately in the frequency domain, rather than uniformly in feature or latent space. SpecKCast transforms the model output into the spatial-frequency domain with a 2D discrete cosine transform (DCT), and forecasts each coefficient during denoising. Moreover, instead of indexing the trajectory by the sampler’s timestep, SpecKCast exploits a time coordinate derived from the noise scheduler and applies a nonlinear time warping that improves the accuracy of local extrapolation within each band. To track each coefficient as it moves along its trajectory, SpecKCast uses a lightweight Kalman filter, a recursive state-space estimator that maintains the coefficient’s value and rate of change, projecting this state across a skip and correcting it after a full denoising step. The filter also estimates the uncertainty of each forecast. As more steps are skipped, this uncertainty increases, while the rate of change decays to keep the prediction stable. Furthermore, SpecKCast partitions the coefficients into frequency bands that share a common temporal coordinate and forecast uncertainty, while each coefficient keeps its own value and rate of change. Finally, at skipped steps, the predicted coefficients are transformed back to the spatial domain and passed directly to the sampler.
blocks.zh: 基于这种洞察力,我们提出SpecKCast,一种无训练的方法,它既重新考虑我们预测的东西,也重新考虑我们如何推断。 关键的想法是在频率领域分别预测模型的时间演变,而不是在特征或潜在空间中统一预测。 SpecKCast用2D离散的余弦变换(DCT)将模型输出转换为空间频域,并在解析时预测每个系数. 此外,SpecKCast没有按照采样者的时序对轨迹进行索引,而是利用从噪音调度器中得出的时间坐标,并采用非线性时间摇摆法,提高每个波段内局部推断的准确性。 SpecKCast使用一个轻量级的卡尔曼滤波器来跟踪每个沿其轨迹移动的系数,这是一个递归的状态-空间估计器,它保持了系数的值和变化率,将这个状态投射到一个跳过一个跳过,并在完全去名后加以纠正。 过滤器还估计了每个预测的不确定性. 随着更多的步骤被跳过,这种不确定性会增加,而变化速率衰变则会保持预测的稳定. 此外,SpecKCast将系数分成频率段,共用一个时间坐标和预测不确定性,而每个系数则保持自己的值和变化率。 最后,在跳过的步骤下,预测的系数被转换回空间域并直接传递给采样者.

blocks.en: The main contributions of this work are summarized as follows. • Frequency-Decoupled and Scheduler-Aligned Forecasting. We introduce SpecKCast, a training-free method that decomposes the model output in the spatial-frequency domain and forecasts its components along a nonlinear time coordinate derived from the noise scheduler. • Uncertainty-Aware Kalman Forecasting. SpecKCast uses a lightweight Kalman filter to track frequency coefficient trajectories and leverage forecast uncertainty to maintain stability over skipped denoising steps. • State-of-the-Art Performance. SpecKCast consistently improves the acceleration and generation quality trade-off over existing caching and forecasting methods while introducing negligible computational and memory overhead, requiring about 5 MiB of additional memory for FLUX.1 ( Labs, 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 这项工作的主要贡献概述如下。 • 频率减震和排程同步预报。 我们引入了SpecKCast,这是一种无训练方法,它分解了空间频域中的模型输出,并用从噪音调度器得出的非线性时间坐标来预测其组件. • 不确定-了解卡尔曼预测。 SpecKCast使用轻量级的卡尔曼滤波器来跟踪频率系数轨迹,并利用预测的不确定性来保持超过跳过去诺步骤的稳定性. • 艺术表演。 SpecKCast在采用可忽略不计的计算和内存间接费用的同时,不断改进与现有缓存和预测方法的加速和生成质量权衡,要求FLUX.1(实验室,2024年)额外内存约5 MiB.

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Diffusion models ( Ho et al., 2020 ) have become a leading approach for image and video generation. Since the introduction of the Diffusion Transformer (DiT) ( Peebles and Xie, 2023 ) , many works have built on this architecture, achieving strong results across diverse domains ( Chen et al., 2024a ; Yang et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2025 ; Rajabi et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) . This progress, however, comes at a cost. Sampling requires many sequential forward passes through a large network, making inference slow and expensive. This limits practical applications and has made diffusion model acceleration an important research direction. A large body of work has therefore focused on reducing sampling steps, mostly by distilling a multi-step teacher into a few-step student ( Meng et al., 2023 ) . Examples include consistency models ( Song and Dhariwal, 2024 ; Song et al., 2023 ) and DMD ( Yin et al., 2024a ; Yin et al., 2024b ) . Although effective, these approaches require additional training and are prone to reduced sample diversity.
blocks.zh: 传播模式(Ho等人,2020年)已成为图像和视频生成的主导方式. 自引入"传播变形器"(DiT)(Peebles and Xie, 2023年)以来,许多作品都以这一架构为基础,在不同领域取得了强劲成果(Chen等人,2024a; Yang等人,2025年;Huang等人,2025年;Rajabi等人,2026年;Zhang等人,2026年). 然而,这一进展代价高昂。 取样需要许多连续的前进,通过一个庞大的网络,使推论缓慢而昂贵。 这限制了实际应用,使扩散模型加速成为一个重要的研究方向. 因此,大量的工作都集中在减少采样步骤上,主要是将一个多步骤的老师分馏成一个几步骤的学生(Meng等人,2023年). 实例包括一致性模型(Song and Dhariwal, 2024;Song等人, 2023)和DMD(Yin等人, 2024a); Yin et al., 2024b) (中文(中国大陆) ). 这些办法虽然有效,但还需要更多的培训,而且容易降低样本的多样性。

blocks.en: A more recent line of work explores feature caching, which accelerates inference without any additional training. The core idea is to reuse intermediate features across timesteps to avoid redundant computation ( Zou et al., 2024 ; Gao et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026 ; Peng et al., 2026 ) . Early methods such as DeepCache ( Ma et al., 2024 ) accelerated the U-Net backbone using handcrafted caching rules, and Δ \Delta -DiT ( Chen et al., 2024b ) later extended this idea to DiT architectures. Subsequent methods further refine what and when to cache. FORA ( Selvaraju et al., 2024 ) reuses attention and MLP outputs across timesteps, while TeaCache ( Liu et al., 2025a ) exploits the correlation between timestep embeddings and model outputs to estimate how much the output changes between steps and decide when to reuse cached features. HiCache ( Feng et al., 2026 ) forecasts features with scaled Hermite polynomials to capture their non-monotonic dynamics in DiTs. SeaCache ( Chung et al., 2026 ) instead improves the caching decision by measuring feature changes after a spectral filter that preserves content-relevant components and suppresses noise. However, feature similarity decreases as the timestep gap increases. As more steps are skipped, the cached features deviate further from the actual ones, and these errors accumulate during sampling. This causes the trajectory to drift and degrades generation quality, limiting the achievable speedup.
blocks.zh: 最近的一行工作探索了特征缓冲,在没有任何额外培训的情况下加快推论。 其核心理念是跨时段重用中间特征以避免冗余计算(Zou等人,2024年;Gao等人,2026年;徐等人,2026年;彭等人,2026年). 早期的方法如DeepCache(Ma等人,2024年)利用手工化的棺材规则加速了U-Net骨干,QQ\Delta-DIT(Chen等人,2024年b)后来将这一想法扩展至DiT架构. 随后的方法进一步细化了缓存的时间和内容. FORA(Selvaraju等人,2024年)跨时序重复使用注意力和MLP输出,而TeaCache(Liu等人,2025年a)则利用时序嵌入与模型输出之间的关联性来估计步骤之间的输出变化,并决定何时再利用缓存特性. HiCache(冯等人,2026年)的预测特征带有缩放的赫米特多诺米亚语,以捕捉其在DiTs中的非莫诺尼语动力学. SeaCache (Chung 等人, 2026年) 反而通过测量光谱过滤器之后的特征变化来改进缓存决定,该滤镜保存了内容相关组件并抑制噪音. 然而,随着时间跨度差距的加大,相似性会减少。 随着更多的步骤被跳过,缓存的特性与实际的更偏离,这些错误在采样时累积. 这导致轨迹漂移,降低生成质量,限制了可实现的速度。

blocks.en: To address this, recent work shifts from reusing features to forecasting them ( Liu et al., 2025b ; Han et al., 2026 ) . Instead of assuming that cached features remain valid at later timesteps, forecasting methods use features from previous steps to predict how they evolve and estimate their values at the target timestep. TaylorSeer ( Liu et al., 2025b ) does this locally with a Taylor expansion, using finite differences of the most recent cached features, while Spectrum ( Han et al., 2026 ) fits a Chebyshev expansion over the full feature history to better capture long-range dynamics. By modeling how features evolve, these methods remain effective over wider timestep gaps, enabling higher acceleration at comparable quality. However, both forecast uniformly in feature space and along the sampler’s timestep, ignoring that denoising progress is nonuniform across steps. In contrast, SpecKCast forecasts each frequency band separately along a scheduler-derived time axis, using a lightweight Kalman filter that adapts its forecasts as the trajectory evolves.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这一问题,最近的工作从再利用地物转向预测地物(Liu等人,2025年b); Han et al., 2026) (中文(中国大陆) ). 预测方法不是假设缓存特性在后期仍然有效,而是利用前期步骤的特性来预测它们是如何演化的,并在目标时步估计它们的值. Taylor Seer(Liu et al.,2025b)在当地用Taylor的扩展来完成这项工作,使用最近缓存的特征的有限差异,而Spectrum(Han et al.,2026)则符合Chebyshev在完整特征历史上的扩展,以更好地捕捉远程动态. 通过模拟特征如何演变,这些方法在较长的时段间隙中依然有效,能够以可比的质量提高加速速度。 然而,无论是在地物空间还是在采样者的时间步骤上,都作出一致的预测,而忽略了不宣示进展是不统一跨步骤的。 相比之下,SpecKCast按照一个调度器衍生的时间轴分别预测每个频段,使用轻量级的卡尔曼滤波器,随着轨迹的演化而调整其预测.

blocks.en: 3.1 Diffusion Models and Flow Matching
blocks.zh: 3.1 扩散模式和流量匹配

blocks.en: Diffusion models ( Ho et al., 2020 ) define a generative process that gradually transforms samples from a simple prior (e.g., Gaussian) into data via a learned reverse-time process. Flow matching ( Lipman et al., 2022 ; Liu et al., 2022 ) instead learns a velocity field that transports noise to data along near-straight paths. Both are instances of stochastic interpolants ( Albergo et al., 2025 ) , with x t = α t ​ x 0 + σ t ​ ϵ x_{t}=\alpha_{t}x_{0}+\sigma_{t}\epsilon , where rectified flow sets α t = 1 − t \alpha_{t}=1-t and σ t = t \sigma_{t}=t and learns the velocity v = ϵ − x 0 v=\epsilon-x_{0} . blocks.en: 4 Method
blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en: Spec tral K alman Fore Cast ing (SpecKCast) is an inference-time acceleration method for DiTs that reduces transformer evaluations during denoising. Unlike feature-caching methods that approximate an intermediate activation and still execute the remaining network layers, SpecKCast models the final velocity consumed by the sampler. SpecKCast applies a 2D DCT to the model output and forecasts each frequency coefficient individually, while partitioning coefficients into bands that share forecast uncertainty and a noise-schedule-derived time coordinate, warped nonlinearly to better align with each band’s temporal evolution. SpecKCast uses a Kalman filter to track each DCT coefficient’s value and temporal derivative, while sharing covariance statistics within each frequency band. The predicted coefficients are transformed back to the spatial domain and passed directly to the sampler.
blocks.zh: Spec tral K alman Fore Cast ing(SpecKCast)是DiTs的一种推论时间加速方法,在去诺氏时降低变压器的评价. 与近似中间激活并仍然执行剩余网络层的特征刻录方法不同,SpecKCast模型是采样器所消耗的最终速度. SpecKCast将一个2D D DCT应用到模型输出上,并分别预测每个频率系数,同时将系数分割成共享预测不确定性的波段和一个噪声排程产生的时间坐标,非线性地扭曲,以更好地配合每个波段的时间演化. SpecKCast使用卡尔曼滤波器跟踪每个DCT系数的值和时间衍生物,同时在每个频段内共享共变统计. 预测的系数被转换回空间域,直接传递给采样者.

blocks.en: 4.1 Frequency-Aware Forecasting
blocks.zh: 4.1 频率警报预报

blocks.en: 4.1.1 Spatial-frequency Decomposition
blocks.zh: 4.1.1 空间频率分解

blocks.en: Forecasting the entire transformer output with a single temporal model ignores an important property of diffusion predictions: different spatial frequencies exhibit different temporal dynamics, as shown in Figure 2 . Low-frequency content settles early and drifts slowly, while high-frequency content remains active until the end of sampling. To account for these distinct dynamics, SpecKCast transforms each output into the spatial-frequency domain and forecasts its coefficients separately.
blocks.zh: 用单一时间模型预测整个变压器输出忽略了扩散预测的重要属性:不同的空间频率显示不同的时间动态,如图2所示. 低频含量提前沉淀,漂移缓慢,而高频含量则一直活跃到采样结束. 为了考虑这些截然不同的动态,SpecKCast将每个输出转化为空间频率域,并分别预测其系数.

Each frequency coefficient is treated as a separate temporal signal and forecast by its own predictor, while the band determines how each coefficient’s dynamics are modeled. On steps where the transformer computes the full denoising step, the observed Z j Z_{j} updates the predictors; on skipped steps, the forecasters extrapolate each coefficient’s trajectory and together form Z ^ j \widehat{Z}_{j} . The forecast is then transformed back to the spatial domain, Y ^ j = IDCT 2 ​ D ⁡ ( Z ^ j ) \widehat{Y}_{j}=\operatorname{IDCT}_{2\mathrm{D}}(\widehat{Z}_{j}) , and passed directly to the diffusion sampler.

A natural choice is the step index j j , but it does not capture the nonuniform progression of the denoising process. As a result, equal increments of j j can correspond to very different amounts of change, making the trajectory harder to forecast. blocks.en: The remaining question is which steps to compute. A fixed schedule is the simplest choice, but it cannot respond to changes in forecasting difficulty across generations and denoising phases. SpecKCast instead schedules adaptively, computing a step when the uncertainty accumulated by the Kalman filter indicates that the forecast is becoming unreliable. This requires combining the per-band covariances into a single decision quantity. Coefficients within the same band share the covariance P ℓ , j P_{\ell,j} because they use the same time coordinate and process-noise model. This avoids maintaining a separate covariance for every coefficient and reduces uncertainty tracking to only L L matrices. We therefore aggregate the per-band uncertainties into a scalar risk , R ⁡ ( j ) = ω ⁡ ( j ) ​ ∑ ℓ = 1 L d ℓ ​ P 11 ( ℓ ) ​ ( j ) , ω ⁡ ( j ) = exp ⁡ ( − β ​ j N − 1 ) , R(j)=\omega(j)\sum_{\ell=1}^{L}d_{\ell}P_{11}^{(\ell)}(j),\qquad\omega(j)=\exp\left(-\beta\frac{j}{N-1}\right), (12) where d ℓ d_{\ell} is the number of coefficients in band ℓ \ell and β \beta controls how strongly late-stage risk is attenuated. Multiplying it by d ℓ d_{\ell} approximates the total forecast uncertainty of band ℓ \ell . Accordingly, scheduling follows a simple threshold rule. After each compute step, we propagate the covariance forward to predict the risk at future steps. SpecKCast uses forecasted outputs until the first step k k satisfying R ⁡ ( k ) > ε R(k)>\varepsilon , at which point the transformer is evaluated. blocks.en: Table 1 reports results on FLUX.1-dev and Qwen-Image, where Base runs the original sampler with fewer steps to match the NFE. SpecKCast achieves the highest speedup among acceleration methods in all but one setting, along with the best PSNR and LPIPS in all settings and the best SSIM in all but one. At the highest acceleration, it outperforms the strongest baseline by 1.1 dB PSNR on FLUX.1-dev ( 5.54 × 5.54\times ) and 2.0 dB on Qwen-Image ( 6.00 × 6.00\times ). Spectrum, the closest competitor at 14 and 10 NFE, trails SpecKCast by 0.5–1.4 dB PSNR and degrades sharply on Qwen-Image at 8 NFE, where its LPIPS rises to 0.527 compared with 0.267 for SpecKCast. Compared with Base, which runs at a similar speed, SpecKCast improves PSNR by 5.5–9.0 dB, showing that it tracks the 50-step trajectory far more closely than simply taking fewer steps. These gains cost at most 0.01 GiB of memory, whereas TaylorSeer, HiCache, and Spectrum add 0.73–18.97 GiB. Figures 3 and 6 show qualitative results on FLUX.1-dev and Qwen-Image, respectively. TaylorSeer and HiCache blur the images, TeaCache and SeaCache alter textures and lighting, and every baseline misspells or distorts the text on the sign. SpecKCast stays closest to the 50-step reference while running fastest. More samples are provided in Appendix F .

blocks.en: Table 2 reports results on Wan2.1-14B and HunyuanVideo. SpecKCast achieves the highest or near-highest speedup in every setting, along with the best SSIM in all settings and the best PSNR and LPIPS in most. On HunyuanVideo at the 14-NFE budget, it improves PSNR by 2.1 dB over SeaCache, the strongest baseline, while running at 3.33 × 3.33\times instead of 2.57 × 2.57\times . The advantage holds at the 8-NFE budget, where SpecKCast keeps the best SSIM and LPIPS on both models, while HiCache and TaylorSeer drop to 12.06 and 13.02 dB PSNR on Wan2.1-14B. SpecKCast also achieves the best VBench Quality on Wan2.1-14B at every budget, staying within 0.25 points of the reference at the 14-NFE budget. blocks.en: Table 3 ablates the components of SpecKCast on FLUX.1-dev at 14 NFE. Since uncertainty-aware scheduling relies on the Kalman covariance, we first compare forecasters under a fixed schedule. Kalman and Taylor perform similarly, with Kalman slightly faster and higher in PSNR, while Chebyshev is both slower and less accurate. With our frequency decomposition and time warping, the Taylor forecaster also outperforms TaylorSeer ( Table 1 ) by 4.2 dB PSNR while reducing latency from 4.59 to 3.46 s. Replacing the fixed schedule with uncertainty-aware scheduling ( Section 4.3 ) improves PSNR by 2.2 dB. Band-specific time warping ( Section 4.1.2 ) outperforms the raw log-SNR λ j \lambda_{j} by 3.3 dB and the step index j j by 4.7 dB, and removing the frequency decomposition lowers PSNR by 3.1 dB. Overall, the full model achieves the best PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS, and ImageReward. Since all variants except Chebyshev run within 0.1 s of each other, these gains come at almost no extra latency.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We presented SpecKCast, a training-free method for accelerating Diffusion Transformers by forecasting the denoiser output at skipped sampling steps. Rather than modeling the output uniformly, SpecKCast decomposes it into spatial-frequency components and forecasts their distinct temporal dynamics along band-specific, noise-schedule-aligned time coordinates. A lightweight Kalman filter tracks the value and rate of change of each DCT coefficient, while its uncertainty provides a principled signal for adaptively determining when a full transformer evaluation is needed. Across image and video diffusion models, SpecKCast consistently improves the acceleration–quality trade-off over existing caching and forecasting methods, achieving the best fidelity to the 50-step reference in most settings with negligible latency and memory overhead. These results highlight the benefit of explicitly accounting for the distinct temporal evolution of frequency components when forecasting diffusion trajectories. SpecKCast, however, targets only temporal redundancy across denoising steps; each computed step still processes the full token grid and therefore retains the spatial redundancy within a transformer evaluation. Jointly exploiting temporal and spatial redundancy could enable further acceleration and represents a promising direction for future work.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了SpecKCast,一种无训练方法,通过在跳过取样步骤时预测阴极输出来加速扩散变形器。 SpecKCast没有统一模拟输出,而是将其分解成空间频率元件,并沿带状的,噪声-排程-对齐的时间坐标预测其独特的时间动态. 一个轻量级的卡尔曼滤波器跟踪每个DCT系数的值和变化率,而它的不确定性则为适应性地确定何时需要完全变压器评价提供了一个原则信号. 在整个图像和视频传播模型中,SpecKast不断改进加速-与现有的缓存和预测方法进行质量权衡,在大多数情况下最忠实于50步的参照,其耐久性和内存水平微不足道。 这些结果突出了在预测扩散轨迹时明确说明频率元件在时间上的不同演变的好处。 然而,SpecKCast只针对不同消音步骤的时间冗余;每个计算步骤仍然处理全符号网格,因此在变压器评价中保留空间冗余。 联合利用时间和空间冗余可进一步加快速度,并为今后的工作指明一个有希望的方向。

blocks.en: This model has three properties that make it suitable for the forecasting problem in Eq. 2 . First, the predicted value is the minimum-mean-squared-error estimate under the model and depends on all past observations. When the rate is poorly determined, the gain reduces its influence on the forecast. A finite-difference forecaster instead relies only on the most recent observations and amplifies their noise. Second, the filter handles irregularly spaced observations directly, because Δ \Delta enters A A and Q Q . Fixed-order difference formulas assume uniform spacing, which an adaptive compute schedule does not provide. Third, the predicted covariance P P is available before the next observation, so the filter estimates its own forecast error. This lets us choose the compute steps 𝒰 \mathcal{U} by thresholding the predicted error rather than with a hand-designed schedule.

blocks.en: The Kalman filter is related to the Wiener filter, which is the optimal linear filter for a stationary signal in stationary noise and is defined by a fixed frequency response. The Kalman filter is its recursive counterpart for non-stationary signals: it tracks an evolving state together with its uncertainty. The filter itself is standard. Our contribution is the state-space model we place on the denoiser output and the way its covariance is calibrated and used for scheduling ( Section 4 ).

blocks.en: D.2 Decision Rule
blocks.zh: D.2 决定规则

blocks.en: After each computed step j j , the sidecar is rolled forward predictively , applying Equation 46 over a horizon of up to 10 10 future steps without changing its state, and the resulting risks R ⁡ ( j + 1 ) , R ⁡ ( j + 2 ) , … R(j{+}1),R(j{+}2),\dots are compared against the threshold. The next computed step is placed at the first predicted crossing R > ε R>\varepsilon ; all steps before it are forecast. Three safeguards apply. The first 3 3 steps of sampling are always computed, giving the filters real observations to establish values and trends; the final step is always computed, so the sample is finished by a true model evaluation; and the number of consecutive skips is capped at 10 10 regardless of the predicted risk. The threshold ε \varepsilon is set once for each compute budget. Starting from a range of candidate values, we run the scheduler on a set of calibration prompts that are not used for evaluation and measure the average number of transformer calls. If the average is above the target, we raise ε \varepsilon ; if it is below, we lower it. We repeat this, halving the range each time, until the average matches the target.

blocks.en: At inference, ε \varepsilon is kept fixed, but the number of transformer calls is not. The risk depends on the per-band scale κ ~ ℓ \tilde{\kappa}_{\ell} , which is updated from the errors observed during each generation. A generation whose trajectory is easy to forecast accumulates risk slowly and uses fewer calls than the target, while a harder one uses more. The target is therefore met on average rather than for every generation, and the number of calls varies around the target from one generation to the next.

blocks.en: As discussed in Section 2 , cached features become outdated over long skips, while feature-space extrapolation does not distinguish the temporal dynamics of different spatial frequencies. blocks.en: Both models use the same procedure for joint views and normalization, applied independently to each model. For each prompt and panel, we arrange the recorded values into a coefficient-by-step matrix and divide it by its Frobenius norm. For a joint view, the 12 normalized matrices are concatenated along the coefficient axis and transposed, giving a matrix with 50 observations and 12 ​ d 12d features, where d d is the number of retained entries in that panel. We center each feature across steps and project onto its first two principal components. Thus, each joint curve summarizes temporal variation across all 12 generations. For the individual views, the same procedure is applied to each prompt separately, giving a distinct PCA basis for each prompt and panel.

blocks.en: Each panel has its own PCA basis and normalization, so absolute distances, directions, and amplitudes cannot be compared across models, bands, prompts, or joint and individual views. A nearly vertical trajectory in the three-dimensional plots indicates little change in PC1 and PC2; variation can still occur in the omitted components. These plots therefore provide qualitative evidence about temporal structure in the retained subspaces, rather than a quantitative measure of full-velocity motion or forecasting error.
blocks.zh: 每个板块都有自己的PCA基础和正常化,因此绝对距离,方向和振幅无法在模型,波段,提示,或联合和个人观点之间进行比较. 三维图中近乎垂直的轨迹表明PC1和PC2变化不大;省略的元件中仍然可以发生变异. 因此,这些图提供了保留子空间中时间结构的定性证据,而不是全速运动或预测误差的定量计量.

blocks.en: Figures 14 , 15 and 16 show individual FLUX.1-dev generations for prompts 0–5, and Figures 17 , 18 and 19 show the same prompts for Qwen-Image, with two prompts per figure. blocks.en: Figure 12: Joint FLUX.1-dev trajectories across 12 prompts. Columns show the sampled full velocity and DCT bands B 0 B_{0} , B 3 B_{3} , and B 6 B_{6} . Both rows use the same normalized PCA scores, computed jointly over 12 prompts with 50 measured velocities per prompt, guidance scale 3.5, and full transformer computation. Unlike Figure 2 , which shows a single generation, the PCA here is fitted to all 12 generations together. Top: PC1–PC2 projections with equal axis scaling; labels identify selected steps. Bottom: PC1 (solid blue) and PC2 (dashed gray) against step index. Circles mark measurements, dark to light blue indicates denoising progress, and stars mark the final state (PC1 in the bottom row). blocks.en: Figure 13: Spatial-frequency trajectories of Qwen-Image across 12 prompts. Columns show the sampled full velocity and DCT bands B 0 B_{0} , B 3 B_{3} , and B 6 B_{6} . All rows use the same normalized PCA scores, computed jointly over 12 prompts with 50 velocities passed to the sampler per prompt, guidance scale 4, and full transformer computation. Top: Denoising step increases downward. Middle: The same PC1–PC2 pairs with equal axis scaling; labels identify selected steps. Bottom: PC1 (solid blue) and PC2 (dashed gray) against step index. The low band changes mainly at the start, the middle band evolves over a broader interval, and the high band changes sharply near the end after a small early transient.
